content.thinking:
`if not 1 <= len(pai) <= 2` — when there is no PAI header at all, pai is empty → raises syntax. But PAI is optional! The requirement "Total PAI addresses must be one or two" applies only when PAI headers are present.

Fix: only check when pai_raw is non-empty (i.e., at least one PAI header exists). So:
```python
if pai_raw:
    if not 1 <= len(pai) <= 2: raise
    if len(pai)==2 and ...: raise
```
Actually, if pai_raw is non-empty, then pai has at least 1 element anyway (each header value yields at least one member, though a member could be empty → error). So the check is `if pai_raw and len(pai) > 2: raise`.

Let me fix.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
p=open('submission/gateway.py').read()
old = """    if not 1 <= len(pai) <= 2:
        raise Reject("syntax")
    if len(pai) == 2 and (pai[0].startswith("sip:") == pai[1].startswith("sip:")):
        raise Reject("syntax")"""
new = """    if pai_raw:
        if not 1 <= len(pai) <= 2:
            raise Reject("syntax")
        if len(pai) == 2 and (pai[0].startswith("sip:")
                              == pai[1].startswith("sip:")):
            raise Reject("syntax")"""
assert old in p
p = p.replace(old, new)
open('submission/gateway.py','w').write(p)
EOF
python3 public_check.py submission/gateway.py
